messages.subject: colour and geom_smooth
parts:
Hi!

I am plotting my data with geom_smooth(stats="identity") in order to
make statistical errors visible. Now in my aestethics I have a colour
defined and curves get different colours assigned, which is great, but
the legend generated does not match the colours of the curves. Only if I
add geom_line() to the ggplot object things get right. Is this a bug or
a feature I do not understand yet?

BTW, I just started to use ggplot2 which makes a fantastic impression to
me and the tool is far more than just a plotting thing, it is more
comparable to a groupedData and lattice combined which makes it
extremely useful. I hope to be able to tweak plots such that I would use
them for publication, will see...


Sebastian
